title: [Consolidated with D.P.U. 24-151] On September 25, 2024, Westfield ESS LLC (“Company”) filed with the Department of Public Utilities (“Department”), a Petition, pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 40A, § 3 and G.L. c. 164, § 72, seeking (1) individual and comprehensive zoning exemptions from the operation of the City of Westfield Zoning Ordinance (“Zoning Ordinance”) and (2) approval to construct and operate two 115-kV underground transmission lines. The Company requests the zoning exemptions in connection with the Company’s proposed construction of a battery energy storage system (“BESS”) on Medeiros Way in Westfield, MA, specifically on Parcels 70R-17 and 63R-37 (“Project”). The proposed transmission lines are approximately 1,800 feet and 600 feet long, and they would connect the BESS with the Buck Pond Substation that is also located on Medeiros way.
